messages:
Maria: uploaded the mock for the usage/billing page — variant C (compact-left, dense-right). putting the org/project toggle inline with the timeline. PTAL :eyes:
Alex: nice! quick q — where does the invoice CTA live in compact? still bottom-right?
Maria: yes, compact keeps primary CTA bottom-right. idea is to collapse invoice list behind a single row: `Most recent invoice · View / Download`
Raj: concern: that collapses discoverability for admins who manage invoices every month. maybe show a small badge with unread or overdue amount next to the row? :thinking_face:
Sophie: +1 on badge. also accessibility nit: chart color contrast for the token-breakdown heatmap is low at smaller widths. need >=4.5:1 for critical text/labels.
Kevin: re: token units — we currently say "tokens" in the legend and then show decimals in rows (e.g., 1.2M). Can we unify to either raw tokens or token-grams (k/M) consistently across org vs project?
Maria: prefer compact units (k/M) everywhere, but add hover tooltip with exact raw token count. keeps visual density lower.
Alex: layout question: if user switches scope to Project, do we convert the left-side spend chart to project-only or keep an org summary? I think we should swap to project-only to reduce cognitive load.
Raj: agreed on swap, but keep a breadcrumb that says "Org overview" clickable to revert — some PMs asked for quick cross-compare.
Sophie: copy tweak suggestion: replace "View invoice" with "Open invoice (PDF)"? that clarifies the format and reduces support tickets.
Kevin: I worry about translation length with that copy; maybe "Open (PDF)" is shorter. UX-bot: accessibility checklist failure on current mock: color contrast, keyboard focus on toggle, missing aria-label on org/project toggle.
Maria: thanks ux-bot — fixing contrast and adding `aria-label="scope toggle: org or project"`. Sophie can you sanity-check keyboard order?
Sophie: will do. also thinking about chart legends — when we collapse chart to small width the legend wraps awkwardly. proposal: switch to a condensed legend with icon-only and tooltip on hover.
Alex: thumbs on icon-only legend. Also suggest a small microcopy under spend chart: "Est. monthly spend shown; actual invoice may vary." keeps expectations right.
Raj: invoice flow: when user clicks Download we should surface both CSV and PDF. quick confirmation modal: "Download invoice for March — PDF / CSV" and a link to billing docs.
Maria: noted. final ask: can eng add an experiment flag to test compact vs dense by default for 10% of users? we want telemetry on time-to-find-invoice and clicks to download.
Kevin: can do, will add `feature.billing_ui_variant` and track `invoice_click`, `scope_switch`, `download_format`.
Sophie: QA: please include keyboard-only testcases, high-contrast mode screenshots, and screen-reader labels for chart segments.
Maria: great — I'll update the figma and post a follow-up with annotated diff. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
